methodology: Two fresh-context general-purpose agents, dispatched with only the legacy tree, docs/problem-brief.md, and their assigned slice of the draft specs/WOs/contracts/traces -- no access to the generator's own reasoning beyond what's written into those artifacts. Agent A: Tickets subsystem (WO-000, WO-002, do-not-port, PB-003/004/006/007/009/010). Agent B: Auth/Reset + Notifications + Migration (WO-001, WO-003, WO-004, WO-005, PB-001/002/005/008). The generator independently re-verified the two most consequential findings (slug-pattern bug, access-log status-code mismatch) by direct execution before accepting them. Counts below are the generator's tally of each agent's report, not an automated count -- treat as an honest estimate, not an exact figure; the underlying reports (see audit/report.md) are the primary record.

raw_counts.note: branch_coverage_pct reflects post-fix state (after the 4 new coverage items were added to WO-002/WO-000 and PB-011/OQ-011 opened) -- pre-audit branch coverage was lower. problem_coverage_pct is 100% because every PB entry (PB-001 through the newly-added PB-011) now holds a disposition; 3 of those dispositions (PB-003, PB-008, PB-010) were UNDISPOSITIONED before a P8-time correction caught during workspace review, and PB-011 did not exist before this P9 pass.
